description.ja: • 『ガンダムビルドダイバーズ』で初期ダイバーのアバターとしても登場する、あの“ハロ”がプラモデルで登場！
description.en: • The “Haro” that also appears as the initial diver avatar in “Gundam Build Divers” is now available as a plastic model!

description.ja: • 手ごろなサイズ、組立てやすさで気軽に楽しめるコレクションアイテムとなっており、耳は開閉し、手足を出した状態は差し替えで再現可能！
description.en: • It is a collection item that can be easily enjoyed due to its reasonable size and ease of assembly.The ears can be opened and closed, and the state where the limbs are exposed can be recreated by replacing them!

description.ja: • 内部メカもこだわりの造形となっている！
description.en: • The internal mechanism is also carefully designed!
